tasks.label: test: coverage report
tasks.detail: dotnet r test:full: every test with coverlet, then the HTML report in coverage/index.html, opened (starts the test servers)
tasks.command: dotnet tool restore && dotnet r test:full

tasks.label: test: mutation (Stryker)

tasks.command: dotnet tool restore && dotnet r stryker
